subject: Sharing a legend between multiple plots in 0.9

messages.author: c7ad2ad4911b43aa
messages.subject: Sharing a legend between multiple plots in 0.9
parts:
Hello all,

After updating to ggplot2 0.9 I can no longer share a legend among multiple plots using the methods suggested by the LearnR blog or the ggplot2 wiki. The problem appears to be that opts(keep = "legend_box") no longer isolates the legend grob. 

Any suggestions on how to accomplish this is 0.9?

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: Sharing a legend between multiple plots in 0.9
parts:
Hi,

I don't know if there is an official interface yet, but this seems to
work for now,

library(ggplot2) # github version
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt, colour = factor(cyl))) +
geom_point() +
facet_grid(. ~ cyl, scales = "free")

g <- ggplotGrob(p)
library(grid)
legend <- editGrob(getGrob(g,gPath("guide"),grep=TRUE,global=TRUE), vp=NULL)
grid.draw(legend)

HTH,

b.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Sharing a legend between multiple plots in 0.9
parts:
Hi:

The LearnR example can be replicated using Baptiste's suggestion
(thank you very much!!) as follows in 0.9.0 - it isn't just plug and
play, the legend has to be positioned in the right place. This should
be recorded in the archives until a better way comes along.

library('ggplot2') # 0.9.0
library('grid')
p <- qplot(data = mtcars, mpg, hp, geom = "point",
colour = cyl)
p1 <- p + opts(legend.position = "none")
p2 <- qplot(data = mtcars, wt, disp, geom = "point",
colour = cyl) + opts(legend.position = "none")

Layout <- grid.layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
widths = unit(c(2, 0.4), c("null", "null")),
heights = unit(c(1, 1), c("null", "null")))
vplayout <- function(...) {
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = Layout))
}
subplot <- function(x, y) viewport(layout.pos.row = x,
layout.pos.col = y)

g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Notice that the viewport location is defined here:
legend <- editGrob( getGrob( g, gPath("guide"), grep=TRUE, global=TRUE ),
vp= subplot(1:2, 2) )

vplayout()
print(p1, vp = subplot(1, 1))
print(p2, vp = subplot(2, 1))
grid.draw(legend)

Dennis

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Sharing a legend between multiple plots in 0.9
parts:
Here is a 0.9.2 compatible example:

```
p1 <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(cyl, mpg, colour = wt)) + geom_point()
p2 <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(drat, qsec, colour = wt)) + geom_point()

gt1 <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p1))
gt2 <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p2))

gt <- gtable(widths = unit(c(4, 1), "null"), height = unit(c(1, 1), "null"))
gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, gt1[, -5], 1, 1)
gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, gt2[, -5], 2, 1)
gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, gt1[, 5], 1, 2, 2)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(gt)
```
